findings.F1: Over every profile, on the non-overlapping 5-day grid, the 5-day return in excess of the coin's drift rises with the day's return in swing units across both signs: the pooled slope is 0.0108 per swing unit (t 3.26, 1,364 cases). The excess return runs from -1.48 % after days at or below -2 swing units (n 23) and -1.14 % after days between -1 and -0.3 (t -1.94, n 353) to +1.48 % after days between 1 and 2 (n 125) and +6.67 % after days above 2 (t 2.47, n 36).
findings.F2: The up side alone does not carry this slope once cases of the same day are taken together. On up days only, the 5-day slope has a day-clustered t of 0.56 in calm bars (143 cases, 50 days) and 0.95 in agitated bars (122 cases, 43 days). On all days it reaches t 2.08 in calm bars (276 cases, 84 days) and t 1.56 in agitated bars (260 cases, 71 days). The gradient therefore needs the down days too, which the long-only test clipped away; this fits the tested book's negative unusual move per case (-0.60 %, t -1.63).
findings.F3: The follow-through is not confined to calm markets or to the tested profile. The slope is about the same in agitated bars as in calm ones (0.0230 against 0.0180). Outside the choppy calm profile the pooled slope is 0.0102 (t 2.77, 1,186 cases), and days above 2 swing units are followed by +7.7 % excess over 5 days (t 2.19, n 27). Inside the profile the slope is 0.0158 (t 2.25) on only 178 cases.
findings.F4: The positive slope over the full range is in every year shown for calm up days except 2021 (2018 0.019, 2019 0.017, 2020 0.024, 2021 -0.017). It is not one year's effect, but it is not steady either.
findings.F5: The one-day patterns in these bars repeat what the map already holds: a next-day rebound after down days and after low closes in agitated, falling markets. The next-day return after a close near the day's low (bottom fifth of the range) is +0.76 % (t 4.55, n 1,032). The next-day slope on close position is -0.024 in agitated bars (day-clustered t -2.62) against +0.002 in calm bars (t 0.27), and steepest in falling agitated bars (-0.042, t -2.83). These are held ideas such as 039-02, 044-01 and 045-01, not discoveries.
findings.F6: Other angles do not stand out given how many were looked at, so none is used as a finding:

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's one-day move against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further the coin keeps moving the same way over the next 5 days, upward after up days and downward after down days.
ideas.consequence: A trader sizes a 5-day position on both sides by the day's move in swing units: long after large up days, short after large down days, instead of buying the up days only in a calm, choppy market.
ideas.name: day move follow-through both sides
